landing.title: Ping — where your team talks
landing.tagline: Instant messages, clear servers and channels, transparent permissions and an AI helper that summarises right inside the channel.
landing.featureRealtimeText: Send and receive over WebSocket, see who is typing, and reconnect automatically on flaky networks.
landing.featureServerText: Split groups into servers, each with its own channels, members and roles.
landing.featurePermissionText: Every action is checked against the member's permissions and written to an audit log.
landing.featureAiText: Ask inside the channel and get a summary with citations back to the original messages.
landing.demoText: The chat frame groups consecutive messages, adds date dividers, quote chips and clear delivery states.
landing.demoMessage1: Today's build is green: typecheck and e2e both pass.
landing.demoMessage2: Great, I'll fold the permissions work into the next release.
landing.finalText: Create an account, spin up your first server and invite your team — it takes less than a minute.
